What is the Live Market page?

This page shows you real-time prices for hundreds of assets — cryptocurrencies, forex pairs & commodities. Each card displays the current price, 24h change, technical signal (Buy/Sell/Wait), RSI indicator, entry point, take profit & stop loss levels. EAM Trading is a monitoring platform — we do NOT trade your money or hold any funds.

🟢 BUY = Analysts suggest going long 🔴 SELL = Analysts suggest going short 🟡 WAIT = No clear signal — monitor RSI = Relative Strength Index (0–100): below 30 = oversold, above 70 = overbought

Trading Signals

Detailed AI-powered signals — step by step entry & exit guide for beginners

🎯

What are Trading Signals?

Signals are data-driven buy/sell recommendations built on technical analysis (RSI, MACD, Moving Averages, Support/Resistance). Each signal shows: entry price, take profit (TP), stop loss (SL), success rate, and risk:reward ratio. These are educational recommendations — not guaranteed profits. Always use proper risk management.

Entry = Where to open the trade TP = Target price (take profit) SL = Stop loss (maximum loss) R:R = Risk to Reward ratio

📚 Quick Reference — What do these numbers mean?
💰 Entry Price
The price at which you should open your trade. Wait for the market to reach this level before entering.
🎯 Take Profit (TP)
Your profit target. When price reaches this level, your trade closes automatically and you collect your profit.
🛑 Stop Loss (SL)
Your safety net. If the price moves against you, your trade closes at this level to prevent bigger losses.
⚖️ Risk:Reward (R:R)
Ratio of potential profit vs potential loss. 1:2 means you risk $1 to potentially gain $2. Always aim for 1:2 or better.

🚀 Quick Start Guide: Open Your First Trading Account

Step 1: Choose a Broker
For beginners: eToro (simple UI) or XM Group (low minimum $5). For Israel: AvaTrade (ISA regulated).
Step 2: Open Demo Account
Always start with a Demo (paper trading) account with virtual money before using real funds. Practice for 2-4 weeks minimum.
Step 3: KYC Verification
Upload your ID/Passport + Proof of Address (utility bill or bank statement). Takes 1-24 hours.
Step 4: Fund Your Account
Deposit via Visa/Mastercard, bank transfer, or e-wallet (Skrill, Neteller). Minimum: $5-$200 depending on broker.
Step 5: Connect to EAM
Use your broker's read-only API key to connect to EAM Trading. We monitor your trades — never trade on your behalf.
Step 6: Start Monitoring
Use EAM's signals for ideas, the AI Advisor to learn, and Performance Analytics to track your results. You are in full control.

🎮 What is a Demo Account?

A demo account uses virtual money but real market prices. Zero risk. EVERY beginner must start on demo.

✅
Advantages
• Zero financial risk
• Real prices
• Learn platform
• Test EAM signals
• Build confidence
⚠️
Limitations
• No real emotions
• Slippage differs live
• No real profit
• Easy to over-trade
• Psychology differs
🎯 4-WEEK DEMO PRACTICE PLAN
Week 1
→ Practice opening/closing trades
→ Learn Stop Loss and Take Profit placement
→ Take 5 EAM signals — record results
Week 2
→ Apply the 2% risk rule on every trade
→ Track win rate — aim for 50%+

→ Test your preferred trading style

→ Aim for 3:1 positive trade log
Week 4
→ Achieve 60%+ win rate consistently
→ Trade with discipline — no emotional trades
→ If profitable: consider live trading with small amount ($50-100)

📊 How to Read an EAM Signal

📍 Entry: $87,200
Price to open the trade at. Wait for price to reach this level — never chase.
🎯 Take Profit 1: $89,500
First profit target. Close 50-100% here. Secured at 2.4:1 R:R ratio.
🛡️ Stop Loss: $84,800
MANDATORY. Automatically closes losing trade — limits your loss.
📐 R:R Ratio: 2.4:1
For every $1 risked you gain $2.40. Always aim for 2:1 or higher.
💪 AI Score: 78%
How many technical indicators agree. 70%+ is strong. Below 55% = smaller size.
📋 Step-by-Step Trade Entry
1.Find signal on Signals or Smart Signals page
2.Check AI confidence score — aim for 65%+
3.Calculate position size: risk 1-2% of total capital
4.Wait for price to reach Entry level — do not chase
5.Open trade → immediately set Stop Loss
6.Set Take Profit at TP1 (safest) or TP2
7.Walk away — do NOT watch screen every minute
8.Mark Win or Loss in Smart Signals to train AI
❌ Common Beginner Mistakes
❌ Moving Stop Loss further away when wrong
❌ Entering without a Stop Loss
❌ Risking 10-20% on one trade
❌ Ignoring the AI confidence score
❌ Chasing price after missing entry
📏
The 2% Rule

Never risk more than 2% of total capital per trade. With $1,000 → max loss = $20. You can lose 50 trades before losing your account.

⚖️
2:1 Minimum R:R

Only take trades where potential profit is 2x the potential loss. EAM signals target 2.4:1 to 3:1.

🛡️
Always Use Stop Loss

'I'll watch it manually' kills accounts. Set SL BEFORE entering. Non-negotiable.

🎯
Diversify Signals

Take 3-5 signals at 1-2% each. If one loses, others recover it. Never all-in on one trade.

🚫
Stop After 3 Losses

3 consecutive losses → stop for the day. Revenge trading destroys accounts.

🧮 Position Size Formula
Position Size = (Capital × Risk%) ÷ (Entry − Stop Loss)
Example: $1000 × 2% ÷ ($87,200 − $84,800) = 0.00083 BTC
🌅 Morning (9-10 AM)
1.Check Live Market for overnight moves
2.Read Breaking News for economic events
3.Review Smart Signals → select style
4.Pick 2-3 signals with confidence 65%+
☀️ During Trading
1.Wait for price to reach Entry level
2.Set trade: correct size + SL + TP
3.Check every 1-2 hours — not every minute
4.If price hits TP1 → take profit, move SL to breakeven
🌆 Evening Review
1.Close all intraday trades (if intraday style)
2.Mark each trade Win/Loss in Smart Signals
3.Check Signal Tracker win rate
4.Read 1 Trading Course lesson
📊 Weekly Review
1.Review win rate for the week
2.Check AI Learning Database patterns
3.Adjust trading style if needed
4.Plan next week strategy based on data

Account Settings

Customize your account and preferences

🔒

Your Privacy & Security — 100% Protected

✅ All data stored locally — Your account data stays on YOUR device only (browser localStorage). No data sent to external servers.
✅ Passwords encrypted — Passwords are never stored in plain text. No one, including EAM staff, can see your password.
✅ No financial data stored — EAM never stores bank details, credit card numbers, or broker credentials.
✅ Read-only broker API — When you connect a broker account, we only use read-only API keys that cannot execute trades.
✅ We don't trade your money — EAM is purely a monitoring and education platform. We have zero access to your broker account funds.
✅ No data sharing — We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties.
⚠️ Legal Disclaimer: EAM Trading is an educational and market monitoring platform. We are NOT a licensed financial advisor, broker, or fund manager. All content is for educational purposes only.
